text: Do you have a history of easy bruising, and have you ever been tested for your bone density or vitamin D levels? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Calcium

text: My main symptom is Delayed menarche. I also have Severe acne, History of fractures following minor trauma, Partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly noted at birth. speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated 17-hydroxyprogesterone confirms Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency, which explains the virilization and delayed menarche. The bone fragility and fractures are likely secondary to chronic glucocorticoid deficiency or inadequate replacement therapy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency)
